skills.description_zh: This skill should be used when a server-rendered HTML page (e.g. an admin dashboard or any route served via res.send of a template-literal string) throws "Uncaught SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token" in the browser console and button onclick handlers report "X is not a function" / "X is not defined", while "node --check server.js" passes, the page returns HTTP 200, and backend APIs respond normally — a pattern that routinely misleads diagnosis into blaming the backend or an unrelated browser extension.
